dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); uses GnuCOBOL with ORCDBMAIN call pattern, Linux file paths (/var/lib/jma-receipt/), and MCPAREA/MCPDATA copy members typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical insurance subscriber (hokensha/hknja) master update processing; handles insert, update, and delete of insured-person records in the tbl_hknjainf table
purpose.summary: This batch subprogram processes updates to the insured-person (hokensha) master table (tbl_hknjainf) in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It reads an input file of change records and performs insert, update, or delete operations against the database via the ORCDBMAIN middleware call. It also writes error and proof files for audit purposes.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with LNK-AREA (called as subprogram)
LINE SEQUENTIAL files for input, error, and proof output
STRING verb for dynamic file path construction
COPY members: CPHKNJAINFWKV01.INC, CPHKNJAINF.INC, CPSK1001.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, MCPAREA, MCPDATA.INC, CPMUPLINK.INC, COMMON-SPA
grpsys level-indicator prefix on some lines (GnuCOBOL group/system indicator)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (garbled in latin-1 view). Source is truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 31311 bytes / 809 lines. The 'grpsys' prefix on some lines appears to be a GnuCOBOL-specific group/system copy indicator used in ORCA. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present; DB access is via proprietary ORCDBMAIN CALL interface.
